Scholarships for International Students

Home Studying With Us Fees and funding
Scholarships for International Students

Get a more affordable degree today, wherever you study from

One of our core values at Arden is our belief that everyone, everywhere has the right to higher education.

At the same time, we understand that money matters can be the biggest obstacle to completing a life-changing degree and achieving your full potential.

That’s why we’ve set up a number of scholarships and regional offers to help students from across the globe earn the degree they’ve always wanted.

Can I get a scholarship or regional offer?

You can receive one regional offer per eligible programme you complete at Arden University, provided you meet our entry requirements and submit all the required documents. This discount will be applied to your tuition fees throughout your studies.

Take a look below to explore our full range of university scholarships and regional offers, their requirements, and how you can get your application started today.

 

International students studying online    International students studying in the UK    Arden University Alumni

International students studying online

The Global Tier programme is an exclusive offer for online learners from selected international regions. This grants you access to Arden University's educational resources and support, nurturing your journey toward success.

To qualify for the Global Tiers offer you must meet the following criteria:

  • Region: You must be an international student that is a resident or national of one of the regions listed below.
  • Eligibility requirements: please review our terms and conditions for detailed eligibility requirements.
  • Application: You only need to apply to the course you’re interested in, from the selection below.
Eligible Undergraduate degree courses (including Foundation Year and Top-ups)
  • BA (Hons) Business Management (including Tourism, Accounting and Finance, Marketing, and Human Resource Management pathways) - (not including BA (Hons) Business Management Top-up)
  • BSc (Hons) Accounting and Finance
  • BSc (Hons) Psychology
  • BSc (Hons) Psychology with Counselling
  • LLB (Hons) Law
  • BSc (Hons) Health and Care Management (not including Top-up) 
Eligible Postgraduate degree courses
  • MBA (not including MBA Top-up)
  • Executive MBA
  • Executive MBA (AI)
  • MSc Accounting and Finance
  • MSc Accounting and Finance Top-Up
  • MSc Business Psychology
  • MSc Engineering Management
  • MSc Project Management
  • MSc Psychology Conversion Degree (BPS)
  • MSc Strategic Digital Marketing
  • MSc Strategic Human Resource Management
  • MSc Supply Chain Management and Logistics
  • MSc Data Science
  • LLM
  • Master of Public Health

International students studying in the UK

We have scholarships and funding offers available for international students studying at one of our UK campuses, in Manchester or London.

For details visit the International Scholarships and Funding page.

Arden University Alumni

You could get 50% off tuition fees on a master’s course of your choice.

This exclusive offer is available to all Arden University undergraduate alumni—whether you studied online, on campus in Berlin, or through blended learning in the UK.

To qualify, you must:

  • Have completed an Arden undergraduate degree with at least a 2:2
  • Meet the entry requirements for your chosen master’s course
  • Apply within five years of graduating

From MBAs to MScs, our postgraduate programmes are designed to help you move forward - whether you're changing careers, upskilling, or pursuing a lifelong passion. Our team can help you choose the right postgraduate path based on your goals.

Find your postgraduate course

Read our terms and conditions.

International students studying in Berlin

We offer a Berlin Regional Offer for international students coming to study in Berlin from eligible countries.

To be eligible for this offer, you must meet the following criteria:

  • Be a national of a country listed below at the date of your application (we reserve the right to request evidence of proof of nationality); and 
  • Have an offer to study your eligible programme (see below) for one of the following Berlin intakes: September 2026, November 2026, February 2027 or May 2027

The Regional Offer cannot be combined with any other offer run by us. If you are eligible for more than one offer, the offer that gives you the greatest discount will be applied.

Pakistani students studying in Berlin

If your plans to study in the UK have changed due to visa restrictions, Arden University Berlin is here to help you keep moving forward.

This offer is available to Pakistani nationals who have received, but not yet accepted, a conditional or unconditional offer or CAS from a UK university to study in person from 2026 onwards, and who choose to apply for an eligible Blended Learning programme at Arden University Berlin.

The offer applies to eligible students starting their programme in September 2026, November 2026, or February 2027. To be eligible, students must:

  • Be a Pakistani national
  • Hold an offer or CAS from a UK university for 2026 entry
  • Apply for an eligible blended learning programme at Arden University Berlin for a selected intake

To be considered for this offer, please inform your recruitment advisor or agent during your application process and provide evidence confirming your eligibility.
